integrity: Analytic proof of each component and boundary case; exact-rational tests supplement but do not certify the continuum theorem; historical priority is provisional.
scientific_limitations: Classifies the whole-plane three-site regular triangle only, with identical positive radial-to-tangential eigenvalue ratio and radially aligned matrices. Does not claim stability under generic perturbations, arbitrary metrics, or clipping. Earlier equivalent degeneracy results may exist.
title: Exact component and pinch-point classification for a symmetric three-site anisotropic Voronoi diagram
